## 📥 Install

```sh
opencode plugin @mirrowel/opencode-openshare@latest --global
```

## 📋 What's Changed

The 0.2.1 viewer already had twelve views, virtualization, scoped
search, live streaming, multi-user accounts, and copy-as-markdown.
0.3.0 is a trust and portability release around that base: shares can
leave the server as offline files, the server gains scoped credentials
and per-share controls, and the project gains a website, an admin
console, and CI-owned releases.

### Viewer

- **Thinking panel** (classic and conversation): the reasoning body is
  now a capped 26rem scroll panel with drag-to-resize, an open/close
  pour animation, and an end-of-thought mark; closed panels unmount
  their markdown. Plain tool outputs pour open the same way; file
  cards keep the kit's native mount.
- **File cards gained** per-theme code palettes, media rendering for
  image/SVG/audio reads and writes, bottom-edge drag-resize, and
  range-language stamping so mid-script reads and edits highlight
  correctly. The existing pierre highlighting, line numbers,
  path-first relative titles, and the 20-line cap remain.
- **Output surfaces**: shell, text results, and unregistered tools
  (MCP, `ctx_*`) share one resizable card with copy, wrap/scroll, a
  clipped-content fade, and a catch-all renderer.
- **Search gained one store** behind the palette and every skin
  filter; every prompt of a parallel burst is searchable.
- **Deep links**: ctrl+click a message copies `#row=<key>`; the link
  scrolls to the exact row, expands it, flashes it, and survives
  reloads.
- **Subagent cards** link to the exact child prompt they spawned (the
  plugin stamps both sides; a token-alignment ladder resolves old
  shares); per-agent colors and a synced running sweep on active
  cards.
- **Timestamps** shown as recorded (UTC), click to convert the whole
  session to your timezone.
- **Transcript menu**: copy markdown, export import-ready JSON,
  download a snapshot — one header menu.
- **Tool gallery** (`npm run preview:tools`) now covers whole-message
  features as well as every tool state.
- **View picker**: classic and conversation flat; reader and the nine
  skins behind "more views".
- **Layout hardening**: measurement, disclosure, resize, and
  navigation survive mass expand/collapse, reloads, width changes, and
  session switches.

### Server and trust

- **Scoped tokens**: full and scoped `osk_` credentials; scoped tokens
  create within their limits and reach only their own shares; rotation
  transfers attribution. Revoking the last full token freezes the
  account; per-token freeze; code-lineage kill switch; ask-once
  onboarding (`CODELESS_ONBOARDING` restores codeless minting).
- **Token management**: self-mint, edit, rotation overrides,
  minute/hour/day expiry, and named config sets (Class A server-side,
  Class B suggestions).
- **Per-share settings**: general < per-server < per-share for TTL,
  read auth, sticky title, and pause (writes reject 423 while paused,
  backfill on resume).
- **Hours-native TTL**: `ttlHours` everywhere; `ttlDays` converts ×24;
  one-hour floor; legacy rows migrate lazily.
- **Redaction** at the enqueue choke point with a consent preflight
  showing counts; custom regex patterns configurable.
- **Private facts**: directory/worktree leave the public session item
  (`pmeta`), served only past the read gate; machine paths rewritten
  session-relative on the wire.
- **Share meta API**: owner/admin-only summaries, gates, liveness,
  expiry, provenance; single-share
